artists.source_line: Dance to the rhythms of salsa, bachata, and kizomba with your captain, Steve Bakoula! 🎵💃🕺
Dance through Greece on an unforgettable cruise with SBK Cruise, from May 2nd to 9th, 2026
Payment must be made by check payable to Martini Voyages: in 1, 2, or 3 installments maximum, cashed 1 month apart if you wish. Holiday vouchers are also accepted 💡

features.rationale: The price includes a cruise on a named ship, so the event takes place on a cruise ship.

features.quote: Daily dance lessons (2 hours of lessons per day onboard)
features.rationale: Daily dance lessons are part of the package, so dance classes are part of the event.

features.quote: Enjoy themed SBK evenings, dance classes, and relaxing moments.
features.rationale: Themed evenings are offered as part of the cruise programme.
The price includes full board, meaning meals are included in the package.
The cabin accommodation package is mandatory and included in the price.
A round-trip bus transfer between Nice and Venice is included in the price.
